You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: grounding_check: article 'generate-and-submit-claims' does not answer the ticket: The article only explains claim generation, submission steps, and specific error troubleshooting, not how to investigate or resolve a system-wide clearinghouse module failure. Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: review_draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Article: none

Ticket:
Urgent: Electronic insurance claim submission failure

To whom it may concern, our billing department is currently unable to batch and submit insurance claims due to a system-wide failure affecting the clearinghouse submission module. Kindly investigate this service disruption as a matter of urgency.

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Hello,

Thank you for reaching out and letting us know about the system‑wide issue affecting the clearinghouse submission module. I understand how critical timely claim submissions are for your billing operations.

I’ve escalated this matter to a member of our support team who will investigate the disruption. They will be in touch with you as soon as they have more information.

If you have any additional details that might help with the investigation, please feel free to share them.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Support Team"
}
